AM.name: AM
AM.description: Light two-wheeled motor vehicles with a maximum speed of no more than 45 km/h, a rated continuous power of no more than 4 kW, and an internal combustion engine with a displacement of no more than 50 cm³ or another form of drive. Three-wheeled mopeds and four-wheeled light motor vehicles with the same restrictions.

A1.name: A1
A1.description: Motorcycles with a displacement of no more than 125 cm³ and an engine power of no more than 11 kW, where the power-to-weight ratio does not exceed 0.1 kW/kg. Three-wheeled motor vehicles up to 15 kW.

A2.name: A2
A2.description: Motorcycles up to 35 kW power, where the power-to-weight ratio does not exceed 0.2 kW/kg and which are not derived from a motorcycle with an engine power of more than 70 kW.

A.name: A
A.description: All motorcycles and three-wheeled motor vehicles.

B.name: B
B.description: Motor vehicles with a maximum permissible mass (MPM) of no more than 3,500 kg and no more than 8 seats excluding the driver's seat (also with a trailer with an MPM of no more than 750 kg or a heavy trailer, provided the MPM of the combination does not exceed 3,500 kg).

BE.name: BE
BE.description: Combinations of a towing vehicle of class B and a trailer, provided the MPM of the trailer does not exceed 3,500 kg.

C1.name: C1
C1.description: Motor vehicles with an MPM of more than 3,500 kg but not more than 7,500 kg and no more than 8 seats excluding the driver's seat (also with a trailer with an MPM of no more than 750 kg).

C1E.name: C1E
C1E.description: Combinations of a towing vehicle of class C1 and a trailer over 750 kg or of class B and a trailer over 3,500 kg, provided the MPM of the combination does not exceed 12,000 kg in each case.

C.name: C
C.description: Motor vehicles with an MPM of more than 3,500 kg and no more than 8 seats excluding the driver's seat (also with a trailer with an MPM of no more than 750 kg).

CE.name: CE
CE.description: Combinations of a towing vehicle of class C and a trailer with an MPM of more than 750 kg.

D1.name: D1
D1.description: Motor vehicles up to 8 m in length, designed and built to carry no more than 16 persons excluding the driver (also with a trailer with an MPM of no more than 750 kg).

D1E.name: D1E
D1E.description: Combinations of a towing vehicle of class D1 and a trailer over 750 kg MPM.

D.name: D
D.description: Motor vehicles designed and built to carry more than 8 persons excluding the driver (also with a trailer with an MPM of no more than 750 kg).

DE.name: DE
DE.description: Combinations of a towing vehicle of class D and a trailer with an MPM of more than 750 kg.

L.name: L
L.description: Tractors up to 40 km/h (with trailers up to 25 km/h), which are intended by their design for use in agriculture or forestry and are used for such purposes.

T.name: T
T.description: Tractors with a design-related maximum speed of up to 60 km/h as well as self-propelled work machines and feed mixers with a design-related maximum speed of up to 40 km/h, which are each intended by their design for use in agriculture or forestry and are used for such purposes (each also with trailers).

school_information.title: Driving School Information
school_information.description: Add your driving school information so your students know where you are located and how to contact you. You can also add your logo. Go to Settings > General.

course_create.title: Create Courses
course_create.description: Create the courses you want to offer. You can create different courses for different vehicle types or classes. Go to Courses and click on Create Course.

course_activity_create.title: Create Course Activities
course_activity_create.description: Create course activities such as driving lessons, theory classes, exams, etc. Go to the course you want to edit, click on Settings, and scroll down to Course Activities.

course_document_create.title: Required Course Documents
course_document_create.description: Add the required documents for the course so your students know what documents they need for the course. Go to the course you want to edit, click on Settings, and scroll down to Required Documents.

enable_payment.title: Enable Online Payment
enable_payment.description: To receive payments from your students, we have an integration with Stripe. Go to Settings > Payments and connect your Stripe account. In this demo, no real credentials are required and no real payments will be made.

course_student_invite.title: Invite Your Students
course_student_invite.description: Invite your students so they can sign up and book activities. Go to Students and click on New Student. You can also invite students by sending them the registration link via email, sharing a link, or adding them manually. For this demo, please add the student manually.

course_student_enroll.title: Enroll Students in Courses
course_student_enroll.description: The new student from step 6 can now be enrolled in a course. Go to Courses and click on the course you want to edit. Click on Participants and add the new student.

activity_schedule_create.title: Schedule Activities
activity_schedule_create.description: Schedule activities for your students. Go to Courses and click on the course you want to edit. Click on Activities and add a new appointment for an activity you created.

activity_schedule_attendance.title: Participate in Activities
activity_schedule_attendance.description: Students can participate in the activities you have scheduled. You can check attendance and update the status of the activity. Go to Courses and click on the course you want to edit. Click on Activities and see the participant list. Click on the checkbox next to the student to confirm attendance.

invoice_create.title: Create Invoices
invoice_create.description: Based on the students' participation in activities, invoices are automatically created every month. You can also create, confirm, and cancel invoices manually. Find a student in the participant list and click on Billing. Create a new invoice by clicking on Create Invoice Now.

invoice_send.title: Share Invoice
invoice_send.description: After creating the invoice, you can share it so the student can see and pay it. If the student has paid the invoice through other means, you can mark the invoice as paid. Go to Invoices and click on the invoice you want to share. Click on Mark as Ready for Payment. The student will receive an email that the invoice is ready.

tutorial_continue_as_student.title: Continue as a Student
tutorial_continue_as_student.description: You can log in as a student and see the platform from a student's perspective. For this demo, find the student you created in step 6. Make sure the student's email is correct, as students will receive an email to sign up. Click on Students and find the student you created. To the right of the student, you will find the eye icon. Click on it to open the Student Panel. Then click on Send Invitation. The student will receive an email to sign up.

tutorial_complete.title: That's it!
tutorial_complete.description: You have set up your platform and can now manage your students. Now log in as a student and see how it looks. Have fun!
